goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09, iter-20/v28). v27 tried 10M/384 (the prior 2026-08-09 committed lock) and FAILED to converge: 2.2631 BPC (w7to9wg0) — cutting limit_chars 30M->10M + batch 96->384 slashed optimizer steps ~12x (43.7k -> 3.7k), leaving the model data/step-limited. v28 re-locked 30M/96 on the v27 optimization set and converged to 1.8759 BPC in 1600s (~27 min), better than and ~2.2x faster than the old 3524s pipeline. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

config_effective.acc: TPU v5e-8 (8 chips), mixed_bfloat16, tf.data (vectorized sliding_window_view)

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~26.7 min (1600s fit) to 1.8759 BPC @ E40 at re-locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget with v27 optimization set (vectorized ds, spe16, warmup150, QK-norm). vs ~58.7 min (3524s) for 1.8833 at the old pipeline's same budget.
current_best.notes: Iter-15 (v23) window-warmup 1.8833 BPC. Iter-16 (v24) bigram REGRESSED to 1.9049 (disabled in v25). Iter-17 (v25) QK-norm build ERROR (mask broadcast). Iter-18 (v26) fixes mask broadcast -> 1.87799 BPC (gpnqp8gs). Iter-19 (v27, w7to9wg0) 10M/384 committed budget FAILED to converge (2.2631 BPC) - steps cut 12x; budget wrong. Iter-20 (v28, z29pp538) re-locks 30M/96 on v27 optimization set -> NEW BEST 1.8759 BPC @ 1600s (best_loss 1.3002), ~2.2x faster time-to-convergence. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 -> 2.2597 -> 1.8869 -> 1.8833 (v23) -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 ERROR] -> 1.87799 (v26) -> [2.2631 v27 non-convergent 10M/384] -> 1.8759 (v28, 30M/96 re-lock).

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-21 (v29, in flight): at re-locked 30M/96 budget, ARCHITECTURE probe on the char-level head: token_dec_layers 3->4, token_emb_dim 128->192, token_dec_dim_ff 256->384, token_dec_nhead 4->6. Rationale: BPC is measured on the token/char decoder output; the small token decoder (emb128/3L) is the direct lever on the metric. Budget fields (limit_chars/block/stride/batch/warmup/spe) untouched.

Architecture tuning is OPEN (not locked): sweep/tune chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, lr, weight_decay — these are NOT compute-inflation and are the real BPC levers. Do NOT touch committed_budget fields.
